benefit_text: The scheme gives a working capital loan up to ₹15,000 for the first tranche, up to ₹25,000 for the second, and up to ₹50,000 for the third. Interest is subsidised at 7% per year and credited quarterly. A digital transaction cashback of up to ₹100 per month is offered. A credit guarantee covers 31.87% of the first tranche, 8.25% of the second and 6% of the third. After repaying the second tranche, a UPI linked RuPay credit card with an initial limit of ₹10,000, extendable to ₹30,000, is provided.
who_can_apply: Street vendors who have a Certificate of Vending or Identity Card issued by the Urban Local Body can apply. Vendors identified in the survey but not yet issued a certificate can also apply. Vendors left out of the survey or who started vending later can apply if they have a Letter of Recommendation from the ULB or Town Vending Committee.
documents: Certificate of Vending, Identity Card, Letter of Recommendation, Aadhaar Card, Survey Reference Number (SRN)
how_to_apply: Visit pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in and click Log In. Enter your mobile number, request the OTP and log in. Select your vendor category, enter the mandatory Survey Reference Number, fill the online form, upload the required documents and submit.
